app.title: HR System
app.tagline: Trainee onboarding, employee file, and offboarding — one auditable workflow.

users.title: Staff & roles
users.subtitle: Create staff accounts and assign each to its responsible group

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: System configuration (administrators only)
settings.gmailHint: Gmail requires an App Password (Google Account → Security → 2-Step Verification → App passwords), not your normal password.
settings.consoleHint: Emails are written to the server log instead of being sent — for development.
settings.testSent: Test email sent — check the inbox (or the server log in development mode).

employees.title: Employees
employees.subtitle: Stage 2 — the employee file: GOSI, insurance, criminal record, assets
employees.empty: No employees yet — they are created automatically when a trainee's contract is approved.
employees.directHint: For existing staff joining the system directly. New hires normally arrive automatically when their trainee contract is approved.

assets.title: Asset custody
assets.name: Name
assets.linkHint: The employee received this link by email (in development it is also shown here).

trainee.title: Trainee Management
trainee.desc: Data collection, contract creation and electronic approval — with automatic reminders and deadlines.

profile.title: Employee File
profile.desc: GOSI, medical insurance, criminal record certificate, and asset custody — four independent tracks.

offboarding.title: Offboarding
offboarding.desc: Exit interview, asset return, termination notice, and final settlement — down to file closure.

trainees.title: Trainees
trainees.subtitle: Stage 1 — from record creation to contract approval
trainees.empty: No trainees yet — create the first one.
trainees.name: Name
trainees.docsHint: The default document checklist (ID, qualification, photo, IBAN letter) is created automatically.
trainees.missingNotes: What is missing? (sent to the trainee)
trainees.becameEmployee: Contract approved — employee profile {no} was created automatically.

publicForm.title: Complete your onboarding data
publicForm.fileHint: Accepted files: PDF, JPG, PNG, DOC — up to 10 MB each.
publicForm.requiredHint: All documents marked * are required before submitting.
publicForm.invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid
publicForm.invalidHint: The link may have expired or already been used. Please contact HR for a new one.
publicForm.doneTitle: Thank you! Your data was submitted.
publicForm.doneHint: HR will review your documents and contact you with the next step.

approval.title: Your employment contract
approval.hint: By clicking Approve, you electronically accept this contract.
approval.doneHint: Your employee profile ({no}) has been created. HR will contact you with your onboarding details.

offboarding.title: Offboarding
offboarding.interviewDone: The employee completed the exit interview.
offboarding.interviewPending: Waiting for the employee to complete the form.
offboarding.noAssets: No approved custody items registered to this employee.
offboarding.unreturnedWarning: {n} item(s) must be returned before the termination notice.
offboarding.settlementLater: The settlement form opens when the record reaches the settlement stage.
offboarding.closeHint: Amounts saved — a Finance user closes the file after payout.
offboarding.closedAt: File closed on {date}. The employee is now inactive.

exitInterview.title: Exit interview
exitInterview.intro: We appreciate your time with us — your honest answers help us improve.
exitInterview.leavingReason: What is your reason for leaving?
exitInterview.experience: How was your experience working with us?
exitInterview.doneHint: Your answers were recorded. We wish you all the best!

bell.title: Notifications
bell.empty: Nothing yet — reminders and escalations will appear here.

ownership.title: Status ownership
ownership.subtitle: Which group handles each workflow status — changes apply immediately
ownership.atLeastOne: At least one group must own a status.
ownership.hint: A user outside the owning group gets no action buttons and a 403 from the API. ADMIN always has access. New records and existing ones follow the change immediately.

sla.title: Automation rules
sla.subtitle: Reminders, escalations and deadlines — evaluated every few minutes
sla.hint: Changes apply on the next scheduler tick (within minutes). ESCALATE fires once per record after reminders were ignored.

assetApproval.title: Asset custody form
assetApproval.hint: By approving, you electronically confirm receipt of the items above and accept responsibility for them.
assetApproval.approvedHint: The items are now registered to your employee file.
assetApproval.rejectedHint: HR has been notified and will follow up with you.
